oneTimers: A $597M pre-tax paper loss on crypto assets Coinbase holds for investment — a year earlier the same line was a $650M gain. It is non-cash, and it reverses if prices recover.
$34M of losses on crypto held for operations, inside other operating expense.
otherDetail: A $597M paper loss on crypto Coinbase holds as an investment — crypto prices fell in early 2025 — plus $21M of interest expense and $6M of other expense, net: a $623M drag below the operating line. That is the whole story of this quarter's small bottom line.

segments.name: Transaction revenue
segments.note: Fees from crypto trading — consumer $1,096M, institutional $99M, other $68M. Volumes fell from Q4's post-election frenzy even as Bitcoin hit a new all-time high in January.

segments.name: Subscription and services
segments.note: Steadier income: stablecoin revenue $298M, blockchain rewards $197M, interest and finance fees $63M, and other services $141M. USDC's market cap passed $60B in the quarter.

segments.name: Other revenue
segments.note: Interest earned on Coinbase's own corporate cash.

takeaways.text: Coinbase's operating business earned $706M. But the crypto it holds as an investment lost $597M on paper as prices fell — a year earlier the same line added a $650M gain. Net income swung from $1.18B to $66M almost entirely on that one line.
takeaways.title: A paper loss swamped a solid quarter

takeaways.text: Subscription and services revenue rose 37% from a year ago to $698M, led by stablecoin revenue of $298M as USDC — the stablecoin Coinbase co-founded — passed $60B in market value. This income does not depend on trading frenzies.
takeaways.title: The steadier business kept growing

takeaways.text: Revenue fell 10% from the fourth quarter as crypto volatility faded from its post-election peak. Transaction revenue dropped 19% from Q4 to $1.26B, with consumer trading volume down 17%.
takeaways.title: Trading cooled from Q4's frenzy

verdict: Coinbase's core business stayed nicely profitable — $706M of operating income on $2.03B of revenue — but a $597M paper loss on the crypto it holds as an investment cut net income to $66M, from $1.18B a year ago, when the same holdings had gained $650M.
